title: 4-bit Adder
statement_md: Create a combinational module named `adder4`. Inputs `a` and `b` are 4 bits each. Input `cin` is the carry-in. Output `sum` is 4 bits and `cout` is the carry-out. The circuit must calculate `a + b + cin`.

sample_tests.expected: sum contains the 4-bit result; cout=0 unless overflow

tests.hint: Check plain addition without any carry involved.
cin must be added into the result, not ignored.
The addition result needs 5 bits internally — 15 + 1 must produce sum=0 and cout=1.
15 + 15 + 1 = 31, which needs 5 bits; sum holds the lower 4, cout holds the 5th.
9 + 7 = 16 exactly — verify this sets cout without leaving a stale value in sum.
